regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Loretta Mry Gibson God bless you and yours these unsettled days - glorious days, however as always, ... for men who for men of good will. can humbly appreciate what enables them - us poor sinners - to glory in actually holding a place of trust Even near - at least in sight of - the General - our crucified Jesus. I am sending you a copy of the, "Prayer for Peace," of which you have likely known away ahead of me. I heard it first, only after coming to St. Bonaventures last January. . . It strck me at once as from a saddened heart. My own heart filled up, at my first official praying thereof.
